source.constructor: Existing F124-Q source generator bytecode through F124-S source adapter, new disjoint FIT and DEV seed ranges

hypotheses.Wingless: Preserve previous frozen Q uniformly anchored compressed latent residual mechanism but fit only on new FIT seeds. No changed training mechanism.
hypotheses.Yggdrasil: F124-S normalized target terminal path fraction is mathematically flat when every public role-only terminal route reaches target; a separately frozen absolute soft logsumexp target-path evidence minus fixed log(number of terminal role-only routes) remains differentiable in public causal-key compatibility without target-mass cancellation. FIT training learns the same original two coefficients for the identical hard 7-active/9-retained F124-Q inference model; source code and inference head unchanged.
hypotheses.surrogate: Per hop score uses original raw-key learned compatibility and public next-role lookahead; exact previous F124-S path enumerator with only terminal readout changed from logsumexp(target)-logsumexp(all) to logsumexp(target)-log(count(all)). Add the preregistered same +3 additive logit bias. No oracle in predictor; maximum 256 soft FIT paths.

training.Wingless_spsa: F124-S 12 epochs, batch 8, 72 steps, lr .04, perturb .08, 4 residual delta parameters
training.Yggdrasil_spsa: Same 12 epochs, batch 8, 72 steps, lr .04, perturb .08, 2 lookahead delta parameters, only smooth FIT objective
